title: Relief Grounds Available in Each Employer Benefit Charging Class
content:
Whether an employer can be relieved of Employer Benefit Charging charges on a given ground depends on its charge class. The matrix below records, for every class, which grounds are available ("Yes") and which are not ("No").

## Grounds by class

| Charge class | Claimant quit this employer voluntarily without good cause attributable to it | Discharged by this employer for misconduct connected with the work | Claimant refused suitable work this employer offered | This employer keeps employing the claimant part time as in the base period | Benefits paid in error by the agency | Employer paid no base-period wages, or the wages charged are wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reach of a relief, by class

| Charge class | Charges a relief removes | First payment from which relief removes charges | Hours test for continuing part-time relief | Relieved charges go to | Relief on the regular claim also relieves Extended Benefits charges |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | The entire claim | First payment of the claim | Not applicable | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | The entire claim | First payment of the claim | Not applicable | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | Weeks while the employment continues | First payment while the employment continues | Base-period average weekly hours | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | The entire claim | First payment of the claim | Not applicable | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | The entire claim | First payment of the claim | Not applicable | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Weeks while the employment continues | First payment while the employment continues | Base-period average weekly hours | State noncharge account | Yes |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Weeks while the employment continues | First payment while the employment continues | Base-period average weekly hours | State noncharge account | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- The three separation grounds (voluntary quit without good cause, discharge for misconduct, refused suitable work) are available together or not at all: the four contributory classes other than Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer have all three; the part-time class and both reimbursing classes have none of them.
- Continuing part-time relief is available only in Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer, Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar and Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar.
- Agency error and the no-wages or wrong-wages ground are available in every class.
